title: MNIST DRN canonical eight-device IBM OM differential-pair HWA pilot
hypothesis: Starting from one frozen clean ideal-differential DRN state, off-chip BPTT with compact IBM OM endpoint exposure on one exact fixed differential-pair array will reduce pulse-resolved apparent-forward deployment KL relative to matched clean FP32 continuation deployed through the same array, pair mapper, inner-window margin, endpoint stream, and apparent-forward endpoint policy.
motivation: The corrected four-device v2 study and the earlier eight-device initialization diagnostic do not constitute a matched four-versus-eight experiment. They use different teachers, logical starting states, units, learning rates, topology encodings, physical populations, and grouping rules. This study therefore asks a narrower internally matched eight-device question. Both arms start from a tensor-identical current-schema canonicalization of results/mnist-relu-drn-kd-exploratory-20260816/ideal_differential_finetune/20260816T135214.689196Z-9ef10aa2-642ca991/checkpoints/weights.pt (SHA-256 5a9dece30a938f00d2022de3e0aa57755e17f754c2df249507dd709bf9394fbc), use its exact bias-free ReLU teacher results/mnist-relu-drn-kd-exploratory-20260816/teacher_fixed_init/20260816T132557.806720Z-fbff3c26-6f6867f1/checkpoints/weights.pt (SHA-256 9a961a77628e365b54fdf59304ec7fddf46f1f4834c4c03cecea9c204f837f52), and differ only in whether compact pair-specific OM programming endpoints are exposed during minibatches. Canonicalization changes metadata only; it is not a remap or retraining stage. The hardware-derived device model is data/ibm_reram_om_pv128_hwa_v1.json (SHA-256 3030e04d6205dc90d0894ac453d2c1c522dffdc004f69b9c6ab7eaf7ef4b8ba3). The study stops before Tiki-Taka, LoRA, or soft SET/RESET recovery and cannot by itself establish that on-chip training is necessary.

arms.description: Ten epochs of clean FP32 continuation from the canonical clean ideal-differential base, with checkpoint selection through the fixed pulse-resolved differential-pair OM deployment.
Ten epochs of compact exact-array differential-pair OM HWA from the same canonical base, with checkpoint selection through the identical fixed pulse-resolved deployment.

completion_criteria: Before either native arm starts, the launcher must verify the exact source-base SHA-256 5a9dece30a938f00d2022de3e0aa57755e17f754c2df249507dd709bf9394fbc, exact ReLU-teacher SHA-256 9a961a77628e365b54fdf59304ec7fddf46f1f4834c4c03cecea9c204f837f52, exact device-model SHA-256 3030e04d6205dc90d0894ac453d2c1c522dffdc004f69b9c6ab7eaf7ef4b8ba3, and both prepared config hashes. Every native command must receive the same canonical checkpoint through --weights, the frozen ReLU checkpoint through --teacher-weights, and the frozen device model through --device-model.

The preflight must create exactly one durable current-schema canonical base checkpoint by copying the four named differential conductance tensors byte-for-byte from the frozen source. It must record source and canonical hashes, canonical catalog order, and source selection provenance; validate the canonical metadata against the current differential/ReLU runtime contract; prove exact tensor equality; and prove exact source-versus-canonical replay equality on the ordered 5,000-example seed-42 validation cohort. Canonicalization must not invoke teacher mapping, conductance remapping, optimizer updates, or retraining. The replay must retain at least 0.97 student accuracy, 0.99 teacher agreement, and no more than 0.001 KL.

The authoritative production modifier must sample assignment seed 84001 under pinned AIHWKit 1.1.0 with counterfactual_repaired corruption and canonical binding order base.conductance_plus.0, base.conductance_minus.0, base.conductance_plus.1, base.conductance_minus.1. The population must have fingerprint d0dfae135fa7b741c46f1178e52f645da4593f7313b4e6a0a71a9b3793d1b2f0, exactly 317,600 cells, zero active corrupt cells, and exactly 158,800 canonical adjacent plus/minus groups of size two.

The authoritative differential_pair_common_window mapper with common-window margin fraction 0.25 must report common_window_grouping=differential_pair, group size two, 158,800 groups, exactly eight empty groups, an empty-group fraction at most 0.0005, zero mapped targets outside constituent support for every nonempty group, positive inner span for every nonempty group, finite mapped targets inside [0, 1], and exactly 16 out-of-bound cells attributable only to empty groups. The pulse and compact roles must reproduce the exact population fingerprint, binding provenance, mapping report, and mapped tensor. No launcher-side regrouping implementation, clipping, performance-conditioned reassignment, or post-hoc device exclusion is eligible.

Before native launch, one real compact endpoint-seed-84002 training context must pass on the fixed population. It must use exactly 317,584 compact endpoints and exactly 16 exact pulse-resolved fallback cells, with policy pulse_resolved_noncorrupt_out_of_bound_empty_pair_only. The fallback indices must equal the 16 preflighted noncorrupt out-of-bound cells from the eight empty pairs; no nonempty-pair or in-support cell may use fallback. Compact plus fallback must partition all 317,600 cells, produce finite apparent and persistent endpoints, preserve target_out_of_support=error and the AIHWKit apparent-forward/persistent-update-state policy, and record finite pulse, verify, reversal, saturation, and clipping cost within the 128-pulse cap.

Before native launch, one exact endpoint-seed-84003 pulse-resolved programming context must cover all 317,600 cells without a controller exception or non-finite endpoint, with programming success at least 0.99 and budget-exhausted fraction at most 0.01. Inside that single already-programmed context, the production evaluator must process exactly the first 100 ordered validation batches (1,600 examples at batch size 16, seed 42) without a second programming pass; apparent-forward student accuracy and teacher agreement must each be at least 0.25. The apparent endpoint is the DRN forward weight and the persistent endpoint is the hidden state for a possible later physical update.

Before native launch, the exact strict JSON and named-checkpoint serialization path must round-trip the nested pair-modifier metadata, canonical checkpoint, compact report and deployment, pulse report and deployment, mapping report, population receipts, replay metrics, and apparent-forward canary without pickle-unsafe custom objects, NaN, infinity, tensor loss, or digest mismatch. All preflight artifacts and their SHA-256 records must be durable before the native processes start.

Each arm must complete exactly one immutable native run with ten epochs and exactly one valid final result under full artifact-hash verification. The post-audit must verify status/result/metrics/checkpoints, the canonical --weights and ReLU --teacher-weights input hashes, both fixed population artifacts and receipts where applicable, population fingerprint parity, authoritative mapping/report parity, endpoint seeds 84002 and 84003, the 317,584-plus-16 compact partition for the HWA arm, the exact fallback-index digest, pulse-resolved selection reports for both arms, and the apparent/persistent deployment bundles. Any missing, failed, resumed, extra, or scientifically mismatched attempt leaves the study incomplete rather than being replaced in place.
analysis_plan: The primary within-study effect is selected pulse-resolved apparent-forward validation KL for train-exact-bounds-pair-hwa minus train-clean-differential-pair. Report the signed absolute difference and relative KL reduction using the clean arm as denominator, plus selected epoch, initial and selected apparent-forward student accuracy, teacher agreement, calibrated and raw KL, raw/calibrated score RMS, and fixed output gain for each arm.

Separately report clean logical validation before programming, the exact mapped-target diagnostic, pulse apparent-forward validation, and persistent endpoint residuals so logical continuation, physical mapping, endpoint noise, and hidden update state are not conflated. For every layer and arm report target and endpoint extrema, pair raw/inner span minimum/mean/maximum, empty-pair and out-of-support counts, programming success, budget exhaustion, accepted residual bias/MAE/RMSE, SET/RESET/total pulses, verify reads, reversals, saturation, clipping, and fallback costs.

Confirm paired integrity from identical canonical-base and teacher hashes, identical assignment and mapped-target fingerprints, and identical pulse selection stream. Treat the completed four-device v2 study only as an unmatched mechanistic reference: tabulate topology, teacher/base, units, learning rates, population size/fingerprint, grouping, empty-group structure, and deployment metrics before showing any descriptive four-versus-eight contrast. Do not calculate a causal four-versus-eight effect, do not pool the studies, and do not infer that eight cells caused an accuracy change.

This pilot contains no on-chip recovery arm. A remaining HWA deployment gap may motivate a separately predeclared matched Tiki-Taka, LoRA, or soft SET/RESET study but is not evidence that such recovery is required.
